title: Violin Concerto in G minor (reconstr. of BWV 1056): Largo ('Arioso')
video_use_ideas: The famous 'Arioso' melody over pizzicato: a gentle, emotive bed.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 2116 ('Concerto in G minor', for Violin, Viola, Basso Continuo, String Ensemble); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Júda Ronén). Edition source: Schreck G., ca. 1904 (reconstruction); Leipzig: C.F. Peters, n.d. (ca. 1904), plate 8982; IMSLP #363999. Reconstruction by Gustav Schreck (d.1918), Peters ca. 1904; PD. Only the Largo is typeset on Mutopia. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
